% Beamer source: an ordinary frame title + subtitle pair. Renders both under
% Beamer. Under ltx-talk 0.5.3 the subtitle typesets NOTHING -- the class stores
% the token list and never reads it -- with no error at any log level and no
% change to the page count (C-FRAMESUBTITLE). One live course shipped six of
% these with the word "Quiz" appearing zero times in the PDF.
\documentclass{beamer}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[c]
\frametitle{Constraint Satisfaction}
\framesubtitle{Quiz}
Body text.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
